$comment: Every third-party binary this project builds with, ships, or used to keep
in the source tree. One row per artefact: what it is, where it came from,
what licence it carries, and the SHA-256 that identifies it exactly.
The 'provenance' field is the load-bearing one, and it is not decorative:
pinned      - tools/build.ps1 downloads this from the recorded URL and
refuses to package it unless the SHA-256 matches. The URL
and hash below are the same values the build asserts.
in-repo     - kept in the tree because the build needs it locally and
no pinned download exists. Hash recorded here.
unrecorded  - the file's bytes are known, its origin is not. Nobody
wrote down where it was downloaded from, and this project
will not invent a URL to fill the gap. Treat these as
unverified until somebody re-downloads them from the
vendor and confirms the hash matches.
Artefacts marked 'removed-from-tree' are no longer in a source checkout.
They remain in git history, which was deliberately not rewritten; a clone
does not carry them into the working tree any more.

artifacts.name: asprogrammer-dregmod runtime archive
artifacts.used_for: supplies the six runtime DLLs below

artifacts.name: libusb-win32 runtime
artifacts.note: Signed release 1.4.0.2. Kept in the tree because it is not in any pinned archive; tools/build.ps1 asserts both its FileVersion and this hash before packaging. Do not replace it with the older libusb0.dll in the dregmod archive.

artifacts.name: EZP2023+ driver bundle
artifacts.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later; upstream notices retained in the bundle
artifacts.note: tools/build.ps1 verifies every payload file against SHA256SUMS.txt while assembling a release, and fails the build on any mismatch.

artifacts.name: MPHexEditor for Lazarus
artifacts.license: see the licence file inside the archive
artifacts.used_for: the hex editor component; tools/build.ps1 extracts and registers it before compiling
artifacts.note: Kept in the tree because the build cannot proceed without it and no pinned download is recorded. Nobody wrote down which upstream release this archive is; that should be established and this entry promoted to 'pinned'.

artifacts.name: Zadig
artifacts.used_for: installing the libusb-win32 driver for USBasp and AVRISP mkII
artifacts.note: Three builds of one tool, 15.8 MB, for an OS matrix that no longer includes Windows XP or Vista. Get the current version from the Zadig project rather than from this repository.

artifacts.name: FTDI D2XX/VCP driver installer
artifacts.note: Version taken from the filename, not from a recorded download. Obtain the current driver from FTDI.

artifacts.name: WCH CH34x driver installers
artifacts.note: Obtain from WCH. CH343SER.ZIP and CH343SER.EXE were two packagings of the same driver.

artifacts.name: WCH CH341PAR archive
artifacts.note: Removed because its extracted contents sit beside it in drivers/CH347T-Driver/CH341PAR/, which is what actually gets used. Keeping both meant every change to one silently diverged from the other.

artifacts.name: AVRISP mkII Windows driver
artifacts.note: A byte-identical copy also lived at firmware/AVRISP-MKII/WindowsDriver/ and has been removed. drivers/ is where the other driver bundles live.
